program: Wingless external raw-input to representation to context-state attribution
question: Was the negative fixed-capacity context-state result caused primarily by overflow/unseen pair collisions, or by sparse overconditioning even when the previous+current pair had a dedicated context state?
hypothesis: Reconstruct byte-for-byte the sealed 511-dedicated-plus-one-overflow context map and current-only control from WLM-LM-EXTERNAL-CONTEXT-STATE-HOLDOUT-R1. Score the identical untouched suffix triples while partitioning queries into dedicated-context and overflow-context subsets and into frozen training-support bins. Attribution is resolved if either (A) dedicated contexts are nonworse than current-only while overflow contexts are at least 0.02 worse, identifying overflow collision as dominant, or (B) dedicated contexts themselves are at least 0.02 worse, identifying sparse/overconditioned dedicated state as dominant. No predictor, capacity, mapping, or evaluation behavior changes are permitted.
scope_statement: Diagnostic attribution only. The scientific predictor is frozen from the parent negative; this experiment only partitions already-defined heldout queries and reports which context subset caused the degradation.

external_authority.execution_host_policy: GitHub-hosted compute only; host must be distinct from LINKDEADKB

frozen_reuse.split: byte-identical first 60% training / final 40% scoring-only split
frozen_reuse.pair_selection: byte-identical top 511 training pair contexts by occurrence count and lexicographic tie-break
frozen_reuse.context_predictor: byte-identical 512x512 context-state successor counts and unigram zero-row fallback

attribution_partitions.dedicated_query: evaluation (previous,current) pair exists among frozen top-511 dedicated contexts
attribution_partitions.overflow_query: evaluation pair maps to frozen overflow context

attribution_rules.supported: Validity passes and exactly one dominant attribution rule fires.
attribution_rules.mixed: Validity passes but both mechanisms appear materially harmful or no single dominant rule clears the frozen boundary.
attribution_rules.invalid: Any frozen predictor, partition, source, authority, capacity, determinism, or heldout-isolation rule fails.

diagnostic_metrics: pooled and per-source dedicated context/current accuracy and delta
pooled and per-source overflow context/current accuracy and delta
query counts and accuracy deltas for support_1_2, support_3_7, support_8_plus
training occurrence mass captured by top-511 contexts
validity_criteria: Exact sealed negative parent and North Star identities match.
A fresh CKB-plane READY_RESEARCH receipt is bound to this exact preregistration and external manifest.
Scientific construction is byte-for-byte parent behavior; only diagnostic partition accounting is added.
No evaluation query changes context mapping, training support, counts, thresholds, or stopping.
Dedicated and overflow subsets are disjoint and together equal every valid scored suffix triple.
Support bins are determined only by frozen training pair counts.
Full Go regression passes before probe; duplicate probes are byte-identical; all metrics are finite.
No tokenizer, parser, external model, persistent corpus, capacity change, LINKDEADKB execution, production authority, or post-result tuning occurs.
no_post_result_tuning_rule: Do not alter sources, split, representation, context map, support bins, attribution thresholds, predictor/control behavior, metrics, or classification after primary output.

successor_if_overflow_collision_dominant.intent: replace exact pair identity with a frozen learned context alias that generalizes unseen pair surfaces without enlarging the 512 predictive-state budget

successor_if_dedicated_overconditioning_.intent: test training-support-gated backoff to the supported current-only relation while preserving the fixed 512x512 predictive budget

successor_if_mixed_or_unresolved.intent: separate previous-state information from exact pair identity using fixed-capacity factorized controls
